title: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer's creator nearly gave him another name. Was it Reginald, Rupert or Roger?
alt: A printed copy of The Don't Die Retired Christmas Puzzle Book tucked into a red Santa hat on a blue checked sofa, with the American edition of the Christmas Quiz Book propped in front, beside the words: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer's creator nearly gave him another name. Was it Reginald, Rupert or Roger?

posts.facebook:
Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer's creator nearly gave him another name. Was it Reginald, Rupert or Roger?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: Reginald. Robert May dreamed him up in 1939 for a free booklet from an American department store, and also thought about Romeo and Rodney.

It's one of the 300 questions in our Christmas Quiz Book, in a UK and an American edition, on Amazon.
